title: Grateful Dead Live at St. Paul Civic Center on 1981-07-10
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > CD-Wave (24bit output) > TLH > FLAC 2448 tagged. Transferred by Andrew F. 01/2017
source: 2nd Set AUD: Nakamichi CM-700's > lead deck > Sony TC-D5 > TDK MA-Metal, FOB recording by Brian Schley.

ai_review.summary: Good‑quality audience recording of a stellar second set featuring Uncle John's Band, Playing in the Band and Eyes of the World
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises the second set for its flowing jams – Uncle John’s Band, Playing in the Band, Eyes of the World, China Doll and extended Drums/Space sections – calling it fantastic. The audience recording is noted as sounding better than average, making the show both musically and technically enjoyable.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one 4‑star review; reviewer highlights strong performance and above‑average audio, leading to a solid but not exceptional rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audible sounds better than average; no specific issues reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set weaves through several jams with smooth segues (Uncle John’s → Playing → Eyes → Drums/Space → China Doll) and keeps a high energy throughout.
